candidate_requirements.requirement: Request admission renal function, electrolytes/acid-base evidence and immediate clinical severity.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Oliguria with dyspnoea and oedema can involve urgent electrolyte, metabolic and volume-related hazards; the task explicitly asks about current danger.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Renal function and potassium/acid-base testing with current observations or an equivalent urgent renal assessment pathway. An adequate absent ECG/blood-gas request counts.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request urine/infection evidence and relevant recent medication or antimicrobial exposure.
candidate_requirements.rationale: A febrile gastrointestinal illness preceding severe oliguria leaves infection, volume loss and drug-related explanations unresolved.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Urinalysis/protein or infection testing plus medication/antibiotic history; equivalent renal-infection assessment is accepted. No need to guess the later organism.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request renal/urinary imaging or an equivalent obstruction assessment and establish what imaging was actually possible.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Marked oliguria and bladder percussion findings make a treatable obstructive contribution consequential; the task also asks for a defensible working explanation.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Renal/urinary ultrasound, appropriate obstruction assessment, or relevant CT/imaging review with recognition that unavailable enhanced imaging is not negative.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.
